name: Slice the Air
body:
School transmutation; Level druid/shaman 2, elven archer 1, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S, F (an arrow or bolt), DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one touched arrow or bolt
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The next arrow or bolt you shoot completely ignores all natural winds, from gentle breezes to tornado-force winds. The spell reduces the effects of magical winds by one category. If you do not make a shot within one round of casting, the spell dissipates.
